summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a Form 6-K furnishing unaudited consolidated financial information for the month ended July 31, 2026, as required under the SEC's foreign private issuer reporting rules. The filing contains summarized balance sheet and income statement figures in millions of Chilean pesos, prepared under FMC accounting standards similar to IFRS. No transaction, event, or special situation is described. The filing is routine financial reporting by an issuer, equivalent to a standard periodic report. There are no deal terms, recommendations, or catalysts to monitor.
